title: QuanLLM-v2.0-qm, QuanLLM Harness, and QMStudy: An Integrated System for Verifiable Quantum-Mechanics Learning
content: We present an integrated quantum-mechanics learning system comprising QuanLLM-v2.0-qm, the QuanLLM Harness verification framework, and the QMStudy interactive learning platform. QuanLLM-v2.0-qm adapts Qwen3-14B through rank-8 LoRA fine-tuning over three epochs, with a random ten-percent validation split, and supports explanatory reasoning and structured generation through an OpenAI-compatible interface. The Harness transforms generated answers into auditable candidates using isolated solvers, claim extraction, semantically reviewed tool calls, deterministic evidence, independent semantic checks, issue adjudication, and bounded recovery. Its v0.1.5 release separates domain-neutral orchestration from an explicitly activated quantum-mechanics teaching plugin. QMStudy combines a sixteen-lesson digital textbook, interactive numerical experiments, contextual AI tutoring, generated assessments, and a rule-driven learner-state engine. Assessment records connect knowledge-node performance to error tracking, review tasks, and learning reports, while streamed events expose longer verification runs. We describe both the independently released Harness and the locally adapted v0.1.3 implementation embedded in QMStudy v2.8. The Harness release record reports successful independent deterministic checks of delivered answers in ten reasoning-and-recovery reproductions, including three runs retaining degraded status after timeouts. The system establishes a modular path from domain-model adaptation to computationally checked explanations and persistent learning feedback.
